findings.evidence: Grep finds this as the only `change` in the file. The removed proofs each had a justifying comment above their `change`.
findings.fix: Rewrite with the `val_`/`_def` lemmas (or an explicit coercion lemma) instead of `change`. If `change` really is unavoidable, add a comment saying why.
findings.issue: `change differenceRootMatrix (K := K) i i = typeDDiagonalMatrix (Pi.single i 1)` has no comment explaining why it is needed. The PR's own bracket lemmas reach the matrix level through `simp only [LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket, val_…]` without any `change`.

findings.evidence: Lines 249-257 of the diff: `by_cases hia … hib … hab` followed by a `simp_all only [...]` list of 25+ lemmas.
findings.fix: Expand entries with `Matrix.single_apply`, `Pi.single_apply` and `typeDDiagonalMatrix_apply`, then finish with `split_ifs <;> simp_all` or `grind`, and drop the hand-rolled triple case split.
findings.issue: `ext (a | a) (b | b)` combined with three `by_cases` makes 32 goals. Each is closed by a `simp_all only` listing about 25 lemmas (`and_false`, `not_true_eq_false`, `reduceCtorEq`, ...), which looks like pasted `simp?` output and will break on lemma renames.

findings.evidence: Near-identical `simp only [LieSubalgebra.coe_bracket, …]` / `simp only [LieRing.of_associative_ring_bracket, …, Matrix.fromBlocks_multiply, …]` / `ext (a | a) (b | b) <;> simp_all only […]` / `abel` sequences in all four `_eq_ite` theorems.
findings.fix: Factor a helper lemma that rewrites the coerced bracket of two block matrices as a single `fromBlocks`. Each table entry then becomes one rewrite plus entrywise simp.
findings.issue: The four `_eq_ite` proofs repeat the same three-stage opening (`Subtype.ext`/`split_ifs`, then a coercion `simp only`, then `of_associative_ring_bracket`/`fromBlocks_multiply` expansion, then entrywise `simp_all only` and `abel`), each with long hand-maintained lemma lists.

summary: The new bracket table and the shortened downstream proofs are clean, but the diagonal identification lemma uses an undocumented `change` and a brittle 32-case `simp_all only` dump. The four `_eq_ite` proofs also repeat the same unfold-and-expand opening.
